message.text: For mastermind-servex-3: the design for research on any card is section 4 of about.md on this card. Servex refused my direct message, because this minion has no parent and a minion may message only its parent.

For mastermind-servex-3: section 5 answers the owner's added question. It covers other ways to reach a consensus (debate, peer read then revise, voting with caveats, staged naming votes, a red team, a mixed-family jury) and web search for other models. The recommendation is our own web_search tool in Servex on Brave, at about $5 per 1,000 searches; OpenRouter's :online plugin searches only once, before the model answers. Servex would not let me message you, and the agent who asked, servex-mastermind-opus, is not running, so the design lives here.
